title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction: The page is a two-line continuation of the end of p.476. In the 'cas modulaire' Grothendieck is building group schemes M_{ρ,σ} over Z, with ρ = [[0,1],[-1,1]] of order 6 and σ = [[0,1],[-1,0]] of order 4 (see the retrospective on p.478). He attaches to special points q of the λ-line (P^1 minus 0, 1, ∞) 'base-point' subgroups or embeddings M_{ρ,σ}(q) inside a profinite (SL_2 / GL_2)^ setting. He sets M(1/2) = M(σ), the point λ = 1/2, i.e. j = 1728 with automorphism of order 4. He also sets M(-j) = M(ρ), the point λ = -ϱ with ϱ a primitive cube root of unity, i.e. j = 0 with automorphism of order 6. He then transports these by the order-3 anharmonic map ρ̇ : q ↦ 1/(1-q), via int(ρ_SG) M(q) = M(ρ̇(q)). This yields M(q) on the S_3-orbits {0, 1, ∞} and {1/2, 2, -1}. On p.476 he notes the remaining problem: M(0) is only defined up to conjugacy, and a canonical choice inside a well-determined conjugacy class of SL(2,Z)^ is still needed. On this page the sentence ends: 'a more natural choice [seemingly] would be among (53) int(σ_i)(M_{ρ,σ}(0)), i ∈ {0, 1, ∞}'. Here σ_i are presumably the order-2 (in PSL_2) elements, or local monodromies/inertia elements, attached to the three cusps 0, 1, ∞. The underlying problem is choosing compatible tangential base points at the cusps of the Legendre/λ-line, compatible with the S_3 = SL_2(Z)/Γ(2) symmetry. This serves the 'équation des lacets' and the comparison of the M_{0,4} and M_{1,1} fundamental groupoids underlying the Grothendieck–Teichmüller relations. The page itself contains no computation or result, only an indication of a choice still to be made.
errors: No error on this page itself. On the previous page the set written as {0,1,∞,1/2,-2,-1} should be {0,1,∞,1/2,2,-1}: the orbit of 1/2 under q ↦ 1/(1-q) is 1/2 → 2 → -1. This is probably a transcription slip, possibly Grothendieck's own.

ideas.what: Choosing canonical conjugates (tangential base points) at the three cusps 0, 1, ∞ of the λ-line, compatible with the S_3 anharmonic action, inside profinite SL_2 / GL_2.
ideas.modern_name: Tangential base points and the S_3-symmetry of π_1(P^1 − {0,1,∞}); Γ(2)-level structure; the M_{0,4} vs M_{1,1} comparison in Grothendieck–Teichmüller theory
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (tangential base points, 1989); Drinfeld, Ihara, Lochak–Schneps for GT and the M_{1,1} relations
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the S_3 and M_{1,1} 'Teichmüller tower' relations in general terms only

deep.surprise_reason: The page is essentially empty: a fragment indicating a natural choice of conjugates at the cusps, with no result or new construction.
transcription_corrections: The first line is not 'rentrerait seraient entre'. It continues the sentence 'un choix plus …' from p.476, probably '[naturel/vraisemblable] serait entre'.
(53) reads int(σ_i)(M_{ρ,σ}(0)), i ∈ {0,1,∞}; this is consistent with the image.
